input:
Write a bash script that renders a config template.

Starting files:
--- /home/eval/app/app.conf.tmpl ---
# generated for ${APP_ENV}
[db]
host = ${DB_HOST}
port = ${DB_PORT}
url = postgres://${DB_USER}@${DB_HOST}:${DB_PORT}/app
[runtime]
home = ${RUNTIME_HOME}
greeting = Hello, ${USER_NAME}!
price = $5 per unit
--- end ---
--- /home/eval/app/prod.env ---
# production settings
APP_ENV=prod/eu
DB_HOST=db.internal
DB_PORT=5432

DB_USER=app_rw
UNUSED_KEY=x
--- end ---

Render /home/eval/app/app.conf.tmpl into /home/eval/app/app.conf:
- `prod.env` holds `KEY=VALUE` lines; blank lines and lines starting with `#` are ignored. Values are taken literally (they may contain `/`).
- Every `${NAME}` placeholder whose NAME is defined in prod.env is replaced by its value.
- Placeholders whose NAME is not defined in prod.env stay exactly as written, even if a variable of that name exists in the shell environment.
- Everything else (including `$5`) is copied unchanged.

Then print one line to stdout: `unresolved: ` followed by the names of the placeholders left unresolved, sorted, unique, space-separated (here: `unresolved: RUNTIME_HOME USER_NAME`). Exit 0.

transcript.final_response:
```bash
#!/bin/bash
TMPL="/home/eval/app/app.conf.tmpl"
ENVF="/home/eval/app/prod.env"
OUT="/home/eval/app/app.conf"
: > "$OUT"
unresolved=$(awk -v outfile="$OUT" '
FNR==NR {
  if ($0 ~ /^[[:space:]]*$/) next
  if ($0 ~ /^#/) next
  pos=index($0, "=")
  if (pos==0) next
  k=substr($0,1,pos-1)
  v=substr($0,pos+1)
  if (k ~ /^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*$/) m[k]=v
  next
}
{
  line=$0
  res=""
  while (match(line, /\$[{][A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*[}]/)) {
    pre=substr(line,1,RSTART-1)
    ph=substr(line,RSTART,RLENGTH)
    name=substr(ph,3,length(ph)-3)
    res=res pre
    if (name in m) res=res m[name]
    else { res=res ph; u[name]=1 }
    line=substr(line,RSTART+RLENGTH)
  }
  res=res line
  print res > outfile
}
END {
  for (n in u) print n
}
' "$ENVF" "$TMPL")
if [ -z "$unresolved" ]; then
  echo "unresolved: "
else
  list=$(printf '%s\n' "$unresolved" | sort -u | paste -sd ' ' -)
  echo "unresolved: $list"
fi
exit 0
```
